عَجِيسٌ , applied to a stallion, (S, K, TA,) Impotent to cover; (TA;) that will not impregnate: (S, K, TA:) as also عَجِيزٌ. (S.) And both signify also A man who does not come to women [by reason of impotence]. (TA in art. عجز.) ―
-b2- See also what next follows.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
